subject: Headcount swap: propose internal transfer + offer exception for SWE2 backfill
messages:
From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 3 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Headcount swap: propose internal transfer + offer exception for SWE2 backfill

Hi Marissa / Stephanie —

Quick context: SWE2 on Search (team A) resigned effective 9/30. We have an internal engineer, Alex Romero (currently SWE2 on Data Infra), who's expressed interest in moving to Search as an internal transfer. Alex has strong search experience from previous role and has been a high-performer in Data Infra.

Request summary:
- Convert the open SWE2 slot on Search into an internal-transfer offer to Alex.
- Relevel request: propose offering at SWE3 band midpoint given scope (Search infra ownership + mentoring).
- Compensation exception: base $160,000 + 12% target equity (above current SWE2 midpoint).
- Funding: swap headcount from an underutilized infra contractor budget (we repool $18k/month). Net org headcount stays the same.

Attachments: comp-rationale-20251003.pdf, alex-romero-resume.pdf. Greenhouse record link included in attachments.

Why this helps: faster time-to-fill, avoids external recruiting cycle, preserves knowledge continuity for Search. I recommend we move to extend an internal offer with a short approval path.

Can you confirm if you’re OK routing an above-band offer for an internal transfer (exec sign-off may be needed)? If yes, I’ll loop in Neha for offer mechanics and Evelyn for budget confirmation.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Hiring Manager, Search
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: comp-rationale-20251003.pdf]
[Attachment: alex-romero-resume.pdf]

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 3 Oct 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Headcount swap: propose internal transfer + offer exception for SWE2 backfill

Aditya —

Thanks for the context and attachments. Quick questions before I sign off:
1) Exact proposed comp numbers (base + total cash + equity / refresh cadence).
2) Confirmation that this does not increase our FTE count (you mentioned repooling contractor budget).
3) Any impact on on-call or promotion runway that we should document for HR.

If you can add those details I’ll take to the hiring committee. Sounds reasonable in principle — internal transfers are preferred when the skill match is strong.

- Marissa
Director, Engineering Operations
Redwood Inference

From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, evelyn_hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 3 Oct 2025 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Headcount swap: propose internal transfer + offer exception for SWE2 backfill

Thanks Marissa — details below.

Proposed offer blueprint (for internal transfer to SWE3):
- Base salary: $160,000 (current SWE2 midpoint for team A is $140k; SWE3 midpoint is $155k)
- Target total cash (base + bonus): $172,000 (10% bonus target)
- Equity: 12% refresh (one-time top-up grant to align with SWE3 on team)
- Start date target: 2025-11-03 (to allow 4-week notice and transition)

Budget/funding:
- We will repool an existing contractor line (Infra Ops contractor, $18k/mo) that is ending Nov 2025. Net headcount remains flat (swap contractor -> FTE). I've included the contractor budget extract in comp-rationale-20251003.pdf.

Promotion/runway:
- We will document a 9–12 month performance plan with clear outcomes to transition to full SWE3 level responsibilities. This maintains fairness to others and sets clear expectations.

Greenhouse record: https://greenhouse.io/boardings/12345 (attached as greenhouse-12345-link.txt).

If OK, we need HR approval for the equity top-up and Finance sign-off on contract repooling. I can work with Neha and Evelyn to prepare the offer packet for Alex.

Aditya
Hiring Manager, Search
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: greenhouse-12345-link.txt]

From: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, evelyn_hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 6 Oct 2025 09:16:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Headcount swap: propose internal transfer + offer exception for SWE2 backfill

Team —

Appreciate the thorough rationale. A couple of notes from People Ops POV:
- Above-band base and equity refresh for an internal transfer requires Executive approval per policy. Please prepare a short memo (one page) summarizing business impact, comp benchmarking, and the repooling plan. I’ve linked the template here: https://docs.redwood.com/comp/exception-request-2025Q4.
- Neha, please confirm internal offer flow and whether we can structure the equity as a one-time top-up vs. permanent uplift.
- Evelyn, will Finance accept the headcount repool accounting change for Q4?

Once we have the memo and Neha’s confirmation on structure, I’ll route to the Exec team for sign-off.

-Stephanie
VP, People Operations
Redwood Inference

From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, evelyn_hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 6 Oct 2025 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Headcount swap: propose internal transfer + offer exception for SWE2 backfill

Thanks — I reviewed the materials and Alex’s record. Neha here (Recruiting).

Decision: conditional approval to extend an internal transfer offer at the proposed levels, contingent on:
1) A one-page Exec memo from Aditya (per Stephanie template) showing business impact and repool confirmation.
2) Finance (Evelyn) signs off on the contractor repool entry for Q4 accounting.
3) Offer language will include a 9- to 12-month performance checkpoint tied to promotion criteria.

I’ll prepare the offer letter draft and tentatively hold the candidate (Lily at Talenthunt is aware). Once we have memo + finance sign-off, we can extend.

Neha Kapoor
Head of Recruiting
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: alex-romero-resume.pdf]
